chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Aslam al-Jabali, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about a woman who was married, committed adultery, and became pregnant. When she gave birth, she killed her child secretly. He said: She is whipped one hundred lashes for killing her child, and she is stoned because she is married.

He said: And I asked him about a woman who was not married, committed adultery, and became pregnant, and she killed her child secretly. He said: She is whipped one hundred lashes because she committed adultery, and she is whipped one hundred lashes because she killed her child.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference in punishment for a married versus unmarried woman who kills her illegitimate child after adultery?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the distinct penal applications for married versus unmarried women who commit zina and secretly kill their offspring, highlighting the Shia jurisprudential principle that the punishment for killing the child is separate from the adultery penalty. For the muhsanah, the combination of stoning (rajm) and lashes reflects the cumulative nature of her crimes, whereas the unmarried woman receives two hundred lashes, demonstrating the additive legal reasoning in Shia fiqh. This ruling underscores the importance of distinguishing marital status in determining the severity and type of hudud punishments.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Aslam Al Jabaly, form Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Muhammad Bin Qays, 
(The narrator) says, ‘I asked Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> about a woman who was with a husband, committed adultery, so she became pregnant.

So when she gave birth, she killer her child secretly. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘She would be whipped one hundred lashes due to killing her child, and she would be stoned (to death) because she was married (while committing immorality)’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘And I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a woman who was not with a husband, committed adultery. So she killed her child secretly. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘She would be whipped one hundred (lashes) because she committed adultery, and she would be whipped one hundred (lashes) because she killed her child’.
